label: Survival models of the initial-state rival and a witness of founded coming-to-be
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls, every individual counted concrete, two mutually accessible worlds. (1) Endless generation with integer individuals and times, individual n existing only at the selected world and present there from time n on: presence-to-existence and inert emptiness hold, every contingent individual comes to be, no accessible history has a contingent-free moment before a populated one, no time has a founded past, and no individual exists at both worlds. (2) In the existing initial-state control, time 0 has a founded past but the contingent individual does not come to be. (3) The existing rooted control satisfies the possibility of founded coming-to-be. These are statements about three interpretations only.
